spec.description: Dashboard to visualize data from the SolarEdge Cloud API, scraped and stored in InfluxDb

spec.query:

|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "data" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["sn"] == "${sn}" and r["_field"] == "I_AC_Energy_WH")
|> last()
|> drop(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "_start", "_stop", "site", "sn"])

from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")

spec.title: Per panel power - best day comparison

spec.query:
import "date"

current = from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "panel" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["_field"] == "w")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r["id"], set: ["181087139", "181087208", "309342696", "309345867", "309346016"]))
  |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, id: r.id+"-current"}))
  |> yield(name: "current")
 
bestDay = from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: 2023-06-05, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy" and r["_field"] == "wh" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["type"] == "production")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_time"])
  |> truncateTimeColumn(unit: 1d)
  |> group(columns: ["_value"], mode: "except")
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_value", "_time"], mode: "except")
  |> max()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

best = from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: bestDay._time, stop: date.add(to: bestDay._time, d: 1d))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "panel" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["_field"] == "w")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r["id"], set: ["181087139", "181087208", "309342696", "309345867", "309346016"]))
  |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, id: r.id+"-best"}))
  |> timeShift(duration: duration(v: (uint(v: date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStop, unit: 1d)) - uint(v: bestDay._time))))
  |> yield(name: "best")

import "date"

current = from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "power" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["_field"] == "w" and r["type"] == "production")
  |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, "production current": r._value}))
  |> yield(name: "current")

bestDay = from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: date.sub(from: v.timeRangeStart, d: 1y), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy" and r["_field"] == "wh" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["type"] == "production")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_time"])
  |> truncateTimeColumn(unit: 1d)
  |> group(columns: ["_value"], mode: "except")
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_value", "_time"], mode: "except")
  |> max()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

best = from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: bestDay._time, stop: date.add(to: bestDay._time, d: 1d))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "power" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["_field"] == "w" and r["type"] == "production")
  |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, "production best": r._value}))
  |> timeShift(duration: duration(v: (uint(v: date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStop, unit: 1d)) - uint(v: bestDay._time))))
  |> yield(name: "best")

from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "I_DC_Voltage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["site"] == "${site}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sn"] == "${sn}")
  |> drop(columns: ["site", "sn"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Warsaw")
from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit:1d), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "wh")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["site"] == "${site}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "feedin" or r["type"] == "production" or r["type"] == "selfconsumption")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "site", "sn", "host"])
  |> truncateTimeColumn(unit: 1d)
  |> group(columns: ["_value"], mode: "except")
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_value", "_time"], mode: "except")

from(bucket: "solaredge_cloud")
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "data" and r["site"] == "${site}" and r["sn"] == "${sn}" and r["_field"] == "I_Temp")
